## Objective

Prepare local instructions, learning bindings and source-grounded project knowledge and readers.

## Scope

- Governance and roles
- Capture/learning
- Core knowledge products
- Home and Explorer content

## Entry conditions

- Owner/runtime interfaces and preserved-content rules are available.

## Exit criteria

- New and content-bearing project cases have truthful useful content.
- Knowledge products and review/source bindings reflect the final destination inputs.

## Risks

- New projects legitimately lack research results or lessons; do not fabricate content.
- Governance edits must precede final local authority bindings.
